basic_info.description: A fantastic investment opportunity in the heart of Mission Dolores! This property features three spacious unitsunits 3386 and 3388a are tenant-occupied, while unit 3388 is vacant, ready for owner occupancy or rental income. With 2 beds, 1.5 baths each, and a prime location just 2 blocks from BART, this is a must-see for savvy investors! Don't miss out on this chance to own in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods!
